deals.travelWindow: Feb 13 – Apr 24, 2027 (new Allegiant route; intro one-way from $49)
deals.whyRanked: Still the cheapest verified fare (~$98 RT from Allegiant's Nov launch pricing, carried over); Canaveral National Seashore is ~50 min away.
deals.soloWhy: Cheap and easy with a rental car, but SFB is outside Orlando proper; best for beach and springs days rather than nightlife.

highlights: Canaveral National Seashore: Playalinda Beach and Turtle Mound
Wekiwa Springs: swim or paddle the 72°F spring
Merritt Island NWR Black Point Wildlife Drive for birds and manatees
Winter Park Scenic Boat Tour and Park Avenue
itinerary: Day 1 — Land at SFB, drive to Wekiwa Springs for a paddle, evening in Winter Park
Day 2 — Black Point Wildlife Drive at Merritt Island, then Playalinda Beach at sunset
Day 3 — Slow morning in downtown Sanford on the Riverwalk, fly out
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; SFB has limited transit and the seashore has no public transport.
guide.stayArea: Downtown Sanford (walkable riverfront, cheap) or Winter Park for more dining.
food: Tomoka-area fish camps for fresh Gulf-style seafood

deals.travelWindow: Jan 5 – Feb 3, 2027, Tue/Wed departures (fare posted Oct 13; may have aged)
deals.whyRanked: $193 RT nonstop on JetBlue per a Slickdeals post (aged); walkable historic city with Tybee Island and Wormsloe nearby.
deals.soloWhy: Compact, walkable squares, safe downtown and easy day trips make it one of the easiest solo cities.

highlights: Forsyth Park and the 22 historic squares
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the squares, Forsyth Park, Bonaventure Cemetery
Day 2 — Fort Pulaski morning, Tybee Island afternoon
Day 3 — River Street and Cathedral of St. John, depart
guide.gettingAround: Walk downtown; the free DOT shuttle covers the historic district; rent a car or rideshare for Tybee.
guide.stayArea: Historic District near Forsyth Park for walkability.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest lists $100 one-way Basic (RT estimated ~2×; verify); Timucuan Preserve and Amelia Island are close.
deals.soloWhy: Beaches and parks are great solo, though the city is spread out and car-dependent.

highlights: Fort Caroline and Kingsley Plantation in Timucuan Preserve
itinerary: Day 2 — Kingsley Plantation, Boneyard Beach, Amelia Island
guide.gettingAround: Rent a car; downtown has the Skyway but little else.
guide.stayArea: Riverside/Avondale for walkable food and bars.

deals.whyRanked: Southwest shows $109 one-way Basic (RT estimated ~2×; verify); Cabrillo National Monument in town and Joshua Tree ~2.5 h away.
deals.soloWhy: Mild January weather, hostels and trolley access to beaches, plus easy hiking.

itinerary: Day 2 — Torrey Pines and La Jolla
Day 3 — Cabrillo and Point Loma, depart
guide.gettingAround: Trolley and buses cover downtown; rent a car for Torrey Pines or Joshua Tree.
guide.stayArea: Downtown/Little Italy, near the airport and trolley.

deals.travelWindow: Dec 2026 – Mar 2027 (Southwest one-way $120 seen for Jan 9; Nov 2 sale at $129 has expired)
deals.whyRanked: Southwest one-way $120 Basic (RT estimated ~2×; verify); Mammoth Cave NP is ~1.5 h and live music is great solo.
deals.soloWhy: Live music is built for solo visitors and bars and counters are easy seats-for-one.

itinerary: Day 2 — East Nashville and Station Inn
Day 3 — Natchez Trace or Mammoth Cave
guide.gettingAround: Rideshare in the core; rent a car for Mammoth Cave.
